provenance.eligibility_policy: Frozen measured importer and original labels. No full-corpus classification for subsequent policy exists in the reviewed evidence; no inferred post-policy filtering.

machine.affinity: 0-31, one logical thread per physical core

provenance.compiler: Rust 1.95.0, LLVM 22.1.2; generic x86 target, no target-cpu=native
provenance.tbm_definition: commit + next-mask, verified exact integer nanoseconds
provenance.ttfm_definition: build start through first ready mask; vocabulary preparation excluded
provenance.selection: Intersection of complete correct expected-valid accepted trajectories, acceptance at end, no runtime error and equal token counts across all five arms. Failures and partial prefixes excluded; raw preserved.
provenance.correctness_qualification: Conditional observed-correct cohort, not full-language equivalence. Frozen-label dialect/format disagreements remain. Frozen revision has a reported unresolved debug-loader stress overflow; release stress not tested.
provenance.comparison_scope: Original fixed five-arm cohorts, mixed completed/reused campaigns with changed source and isolation/observer conditions; no causal improvement claim.
provenance.display_policy: Four displayed arms use the unchanged fixed five-arm campaign intersections; presentation filtering does not recalculate cohort membership or measurements.

static_source.clock_observer: Original wall clock calls plus RAM logger; CPU31 kernel trace; no PMU; no timing subtraction
static_source.aggregation: One raw observation per schema and aligned token position, deterministic complete same-host paired chunks; no minima across trials and no timing subtraction.
